description: This file defines the CatalogProvider class which extends ChangeNotifier. It manages loading categories and new arrival books by fetching data from CatalogService and notifies listeners about the loading state and data updates.

classes.name: CatalogProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that loads categories and new arrivals for the catalog, managing loading states and notifying listeners.

methods.name: loadHome
methods.description: Asynchronously loads categories and books, updates the provider state, and notifies listeners about changes.
